why: Drops the gallery workbench out of the population `activePanelContainer` derives. This is the regression as it shipped: issue #741 added the pane to the paint order and not to the keyboard's list, so arrows and a D-pad moved nothing inside it and Confirm landed nowhere. The entry survives the move from a hand-written array to a derivation because it pins something the derivation's own entries cannot -- that THIS pane is swept, rather than that some pane is.
